title: P0.32: Governed User Chrome Bridge / External Session Selection
description: Implements governed session selection when external consultation fails due to browser_security_verification in IABV's isolated profile. The user can now choose between: (1) resolve verification in IABV's isolated window, (2) grant CDP permission to let IABV observe their Chrome normal, (3) paste response manually. Permission is explicit, revocable, and traced.
resume_hint: Implementation done. CDP detection, permission grant/revoke, session selection message, OSES finding, and traces all implemented. Awaiting live Windows proof: user opens IABV, triggers external consultation block, writes 'usar mi chrome' to grant CDP permission.
next_action: Live proof on Windows: trigger browser_security_verification, confirm session selection message shows 3 options (or 2 if CDP unavailable), test 'usar mi chrome' and 'revocar permiso cdp'.

Hooked into sendChat flow: bridge selection and revoke checked before security retest

reason: IABV uses an isolated browser profile for external consultations. When this profile hits security verification, the user's logged-in Chrome session cannot help because they are separate profiles. A governed bridge lets the user explicitly grant observation permission.
